snippet.title: Sunhara: Ecorpy Islands - WIP Series - Mushroom Campsite #3
snippet.description:
Our game is called "Sunhara: Ecorpy Islands", a 3D platformer inspired by "Here Comes Niko!" and "Super Mario Sunhine"!

Wishlist the game on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/2339090/Sunhara__Ecorpy_Islands/

And follow us on Twitter - X : https://twitter.com/cloveratelia

You can also register on the Kickstarter pre-launch page : https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/cloveratelia/sunhara-ecorpy-islands
